answer: Degree verification charges each extra identity one 4-year degree, about $48,000 tuition; a farm fielding N fakes owes N×$48,000, and the charge cannot be shared because one record names one graduate and backs one seat. The National Student Clearinghouse files records from 3,600 colleges covering 97% of US enrolments; each file bears an umber seal in a canyon of transcripts, and each graduate crosses a terrace of registrar checks. A farm cloning one degree dies by transcript match at 2: the registrar voids both seats and keeps the $48,000.
